definitions.gloss: extensive reading; reading a large quantity of material
definitions.explanation: A reading approach that emphasizes quantity and breadth, reading many books or texts rather than studying each one in depth. Widely used in language learning contexts to describe reading large amounts of comprehensible material for fluency development.

examples.japanese: {多読|たどく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{語彙|ごい}→語彙：14214_goi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多読|たどく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I keep up my extensive reading in English every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{精読|せいどく}→精読：15982_seidoku⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{多読|たどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The teacher said that extensive reading is more effective than intensive reading.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as {多読|たどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Frequently contrasted with ⟦{精読|せいどく}→精読：15982_seidoku⟧ (intensive, careful reading). In language education, {多読|たどく} has become a well-known methodology where learners read large amounts of easy material to build fluency naturally.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多読|たどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to read extensively)
- {多読|たどく}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (extensive reading method)
- ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧{多読|たどく} (extensive reading in English)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精読|せいどく}→精読：15982_seidoku⟧: intensive reading — reading carefully for full comprehension (opposite approach)
- ⟦{乱読|らんどく}→乱読：20367_randoku⟧: reading indiscriminately, without a plan or system
